title: KAHRELUM 100-Forecast Prospective Challenge
disclosure: Open, unscored forecasts. Later reissues carry forward earlier records; source verification, adversarial review and resolution are incomplete. This is not certified forecasting performance.

records.question: Will UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya adopt a formal consensus cover decision mentioning 'transitioning away from fossil fuels' or fossil fuel phase-out/down?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official UNFCCC COP31 final cover decision text includes explicit 'transitioning away from fossil fuels' or phase-out/down language; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the IAEA Board of Governors adopt a formal resolution censuring or finding Iran in safeguards non-compliance at its Nov 16-20, 2026 meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if IAEA Board of Governors formally adopts a resolution on Iran safeguards during the Nov 16-20, 2026 session; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will PP and Vox win a combined absolute majority (>=176 of 350 seats) in Spain's Congress of Deputies on Nov 29, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official Spanish Ministry of Interior results give PP + Vox >=176 seats; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Swiss voters approve (>50% Yes) the amendment to the War Material Act in the Nov 29, 2026 federal referendum?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Swiss Federal Chancellery certifies >50.0% national Yes vote on the War Material Act amendment; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will incumbent President Adama Barrow (NPP) be declared winner of The Gambia's Dec 5, 2026 presidential election?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Gambia's Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) declares Adama Barrow winner; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the US Congress pass and the President sign a federal funding bill (CR or omnibus) on or before Dec 11, 2026, avoiding a shutdown?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if federal funding legislation is signed into law on or before 2026-12-11T23:59:59 EST without an appropriations lapse; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the governments of Russia and Ukraine jointly announce a comprehensive, nationwide land-front ceasefire agreement by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if both governments publicly affirm the same bilateral ceasefire agreement covering the full land front by cutoff; local truces or one-sided proposals do not qualify. NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the US and Iran jointly announce a formal agreement ending direct kinetic hostilities and restoring routine commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if both governments publish mutually consistent statements covering BOTH cessation of direct kinetic hostilities and unimpeded commercial transit by cutoff. Unilateral proposals or an unimplemented framework are NO.

records.question: Will a new underground nuclear-weapons detonation attributable to North Korea occur from 2026-11-13 00:00 UTC through 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if a new underground nuclear detonation during the window is confirmed by CTBTO/authoritative seismic evidence and credible official reporting. Missile launches, non-nuclear explosions and older detonations are NO.

records.question: Will a newly constituted Israeli government win a formal Knesset vote of confidence by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if official Knesset proceedings record a confidence vote successfully installing a NEW government by cutoff; reshuffles without a new government confidence vote do not qualify.

records.question: Will the G20 Miami Leaders' Summit (Dec 14-15, 2026) issue a joint Leaders' Declaration endorsed by all participating members (rather than a Chair's Summary)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official G20 Miami host publishes a consensus Leaders' Declaration; NO if only a Chair's Summary or no joint text is issued.

records.question: Will the European Council (Dec 17-18, 2026) formally endorse opening at least one EU accession negotiation cluster with Ukraine?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official Dec 17-18, 2026 European Council conclusions approve opening >=1 accession cluster with Ukraine; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the UN Security Council adopt a resolution renewing MONUSCO's mandate in the DRC on or before Dec 20, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if UNSC adopts a resolution extending MONUSCO beyond Dec 20, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will South Sudan hold national general election voting as scheduled on Dec 22, 2026 (without postponement)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if polling stations open nationwide on Dec 22, 2026 for South Sudan's general election; NO if postponed or cancelled.

records.question: Will Serbia hold its early presidential election (first round) on or before Dec 27, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Serbia's Republic Electoral Commission (RIK) holds first-round presidential voting on or before Dec 27, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the UN Security Council adopt a new resolution extending UNIFIL or authorizing a UN-led replacement peacekeeping force before Dec 31, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if UNSC adopts a resolution extending UNIFIL's operational mandate or creating a UN-led successor force by Dec 31, 2026; NO if UNSCR 2790 drawdown begins.

records.question: Will the UN Security Council adopt a resolution renewing AUSSOM's authorization in Somalia beyond Dec 31, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if UNSC adopts a resolution extending AUSSOM's mandate into 2027 on or before Dec 31, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Rep. Hakeem Jeffries (D) be elected Speaker of the US House of Representatives on Jan 3, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if House Clerk/roll-call certifies Hakeem Jeffries elected Speaker on Jan 3, 2027 (EST); NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Nigeria's INEC hold the Presidential and National Assembly elections on Jan 16, 2027 without a nationwide postponement?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if nationwide presidential voting occurs on Jan 16, 2027; NO if INEC postpones the election date.

records.question: Will voting for Kyrgyzstan's presidential election take place nationwide on the officially scheduled date of 27 January 2027, without a nationwide postponement?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if the Kyrgyz Central Election Commission confirms that presidential election polling took place nationwide on January 27, 2027. NO if election is officially postponed or no nationwide polling is held on that date. Overseas polling disruptions alone do not qualify as nationwide postponement.

records.question: Will Alibaba publish open-weight model checkpoints for a Qwen 4 model on Hugging Face or ModelScope on or before Nov 30, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official Qwen/Alibaba Hugging Face or ModelScope repo publishes Qwen 4 weights by Nov 30, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Google DeepMind release or publicly preview a new Gemini 4 family model or major named update between Nov 13 and Nov 30, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Google/DeepMind official blog or API changelog announces a new named Gemini 4 model/update after Nov 13 and by Nov 30, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Meta publicly release a new major Muse- or Llama-family foundation-model version (weights or public API) between 2026-11-20 00:00 UTC and 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Meta's official newsroom or model repository makes a distinct newly named major Muse/Llama foundation-model release accessible during the window. Research previews and minor patches do not qualify.

records.question: Will the European Commission or EU AI Office issue a new official compliance or enforcement communication referring to the AI Act's December 2, 2026 transparency/CSAM/NCII provisions by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if an official European Commission or EU AI Office publication issued after this prospective lock and by cutoff explicitly addresses those December 2 obligations. General preexisting FAQs are excluded.

records.question: Will Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) report full-year FY2026 AI revenue >= $58.0 billion in its Dec 9, 2026 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Broadcom's official Dec 9, 2026 FY26 earnings release/call reports FY26 AI revenue >= $58.0B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will an Anthropic Claude model be ranked #1 on the publicly visible LMArena Agent leaderboard as of 2026-12-11 23:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if an archived contemporaneous leaderboard snapshot taken on December 11 near 23:00 UTC places a Claude model first in the Agent category. NO if another model leads; if no reproducible snapshot is obtainable, mark UNRESOLVABLE, not NO.

records.question: Will DeepSeek officially make DeepSeek V5 available via open weights or public API by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if an official DeepSeek repository, API documentation, or company announcement confirms a publicly available model explicitly named V5 by cutoff; rumors and older versions are NO.

records.question: Will xAI officially offer Grok 5 to paying X subscribers or the public API by 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if the model explicitly named Grok 5 is available to eligible subscribers or through an official public API by cutoff; previews and Grok 4.x versions are NO.

records.question: Will at least one paper receiving a NeurIPS 2026 main-conference Best Paper or Outstanding Paper award have the exact substring 'benchmark' or 'dataset' in its published title (case-insensitive) by 12 December 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if the official NeurIPS 2026 main-conference Best/Outstanding Paper winners announced no later than the cutoff include at least one winning paper whose title contains the exact case-insensitive character substring 'benchmark' or 'dataset'. NO otherwise, including if no official award list is released by cutoff. Exclude workshops, honors mentions and nominations.

records.question: Will Anil Chakravarthy formally assume office as Adobe's President and CEO on Dec 1, 2026 as scheduled?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Adobe's SEC 8-K/official press release confirms Chakravarthy assumed CEO office on Dec 1, 2026; NO if delayed or altered.

records.question: Will NVIDIA announce a new consumer or data-center AI GPU/architecture product at or before CES 2027 (Jan 9, 2027)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if NVIDIA officially unveils a new GPU/AI architecture SKU between Nov 20, 2026 and Jan 9, 2027; NO for software-only updates.

records.question: Will Colorado's SB 26-189 AI/ADMT law enter into enforceable effect on Jan 1, 2027 without a statewide judicial stay or repeal?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if SB 26-189 takes enforceable effect on Jan 1, 2027; NO if blocked by court injunction/stay or legislative delay.

records.question: Will Rocket Lab's Neutron rocket attempt its inaugural liftoff from the launch pad by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Rocket Lab or a recognized launch authority documents first Neutron liftoff by cutoff, irrespective of orbital success; pad tests, static fires, and rollout alone are NO.

records.question: Will SpaceX conduct a Starship flight formally designated Flight 16, including liftoff, between 2026-11-20 00:00 UTC and 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if SpaceX and/or FAA flight records identify a liftoff designated Starship Flight 16 in the specified interval. Other numbered flights, static fires and mere license approvals are NO.

records.question: Will Lenovo unveil at least one new commercial Hybrid AI PC or edge-AI hardware device at Tech World @ CES 2027 (Jan 6-9, 2027)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Lenovo official CES 2027 press releases unveil >=1 new commercial AI PC/edge-AI device; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will TSMC report Q4 2026 consolidated revenue growth >= 25.0% YoY in TWD in its Jan 2027 quarterly release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if TSMC's official Q4 2026 earnings release reports consolidated TWD revenue up >=25.0% YoY; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) report Q4 2026 total revenue >= $74.5 billion (guidance midpoint) in its Jan 2027 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Meta's official Q4 2026 earnings release reports total revenue >= $74.50B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Waymo start a publicly bookable, fully driverless passenger ride-hailing service in Madrid or Toronto by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Waymo's official service launch confirms paying or invited public passengers can request rides without any human safety driver in either city by cutoff. Manual testing, safety-driver pilots and demos are NO.

records.question: Will a US federal court issue a publicly docketed, substantive order changing or staying a remedy in the DOJ's Google search or ad-tech antitrust cases by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if a docketed order in US v Google search (D.D.C./DC Circuit) or US v Google ad-tech (E.D. Va./appeal) affirmatively changes, stays, suspends, or vacates a remedy by cutoff. Routine scheduling or order denying all relief is NO.

records.question: Will OpenAI release an API-accessible frontier model explicitly named GPT-6.2, GPT-6.5, or GPT-7 by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if official OpenAI API documentation or product releases show public API availability of at least one of those exact model family names by cutoff. GPT-6.1 variants and non-API previews are NO.

records.question: Will BLS report Nov 2026 US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) net change >= +100,000 in its Dec 4, 2026 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BLS Employment Situation (Dec 4, 2026) headline Nov 2026 NFP is >= +100K; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BLS report Nov 2026 US U-3 Unemployment Rate <= 4.2% in its Dec 4, 2026 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BLS Dec 4, 2026 release reports Nov 2026 U-3 rate <= 4.2%; NO if >= 4.3%.

records.question: Will the FOMC raise the federal funds target range by >= 25 bps (to >= 4.00%-4.25%) at its Dec 8-9, 2026 meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official Dec 9, 2026 FOMC statement sets target range lower bound >= 4.00%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the FOMC raise the federal funds target range by >= 50 bps in a single move at its Dec 8-9, 2026 meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Dec 9, 2026 FOMC statement raises target range by >= 50 bps from 3.75%-4.00%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BLS report Nov 2026 US Headline CPI-U MoM (seasonally adjusted) >= +0.3% in its Dec 10, 2026 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BLS Dec 10, 2026 CPI release reports Nov 2026 all-items SA MoM change >= +0.3%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will ICE Brent Crude front-month futures settle >= $88.00/bbl on Friday, Dec 11, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official ICE Brent front-month settlement on Dec 11, 2026 is >= $88.00/bbl; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the US 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity yield (FRED: DGS10) close >= 4.90% on Friday, Dec 11, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if US Treasury / FRED DGS10 for Dec 11, 2026 is >= 4.90%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BTC/USD be at least US$75,000 at 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC using Coinbase's BTC-USD last eligible trade during that UTC minute?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Coinbase BTC-USD trade history shows the last trade timestamped between 23:59:00 and 23:59:59 UTC on Dec 11 at or above $75,000. NO otherwise; archive exact trade ID and UTC timestamp.

records.question: Will Comex Gold front-month futures settle >= $3,900.00/t.oz on Friday, Dec 11, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if CME/Comex front-month gold settlement on Dec 11, 2026 is >= $3,900.00/t.oz; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the Federal Reserve H.10 daily USD/JPY noon-buying rate for Friday December 11, 2026 (FRED series DEXJPUS, Japanese yen per U.S. dollar) be at least 158.00?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if the Federal Reserve H.10 / FRED DEXJPUS first-published daily observation for 2026-12-11 is >=158.00 JPY per USD; NO if <158.00. Record the first release vintage; if missing by deadline mark UNRESOLVABLE rather than silently substituting another FX provider.

records.question: Will the ECB Governing Council raise its Deposit Facility Rate (currently 2.50%) on Dec 17, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if ECB's Dec 17, 2026 monetary policy decision sets Deposit Facility Rate > 2.50%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the Bank of England MPC hold Bank Rate at 4.00% at its Dec 17, 2026 meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BoE Dec 17, 2026 MPC decision maintains Bank Rate at 4.00%; NO if hiked or cut.

records.question: Will the Bank of Japan raise its short-term policy rate at its Dec 17-18, 2026 Monetary Policy Meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BoJ's Dec 18, 2026 MPM statement increases the uncollateralized overnight call rate target; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BEA's Third Estimate of Q3 2026 US Real GDP (Dec 23, 2026) report annualized growth >= +2.0%?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BEA's Dec 23, 2026 Q3 2026 Third Estimate reports annualized real GDP growth >= 2.0%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BLS report Dec 2026 US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) net change >= +100,000 in its Jan 8, 2027 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BLS Employment Situation (Jan 8, 2027) reports Dec 2026 NFP >= +100K; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BLS report Dec 2026 US Headline CPI 12-month YoY inflation >= 3.5% in its Jan 13, 2027 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BLS Jan 13, 2027 CPI release reports Dec 2026 all-items 12-month YoY >= 3.5%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the FOMC set its federal funds target range at >= 4.25%-4.50% after its Jan 26-27, 2027 meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Jan 27, 2027 FOMC statement sets target range lower bound >= 4.25%; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will BEA's Advance Estimate of Q4 2026 US Real GDP (Jan 28, 2027) report positive annualized growth (>= 0.0%)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BEA's Jan 28, 2027 Advance Estimate reports Q4 2026 real GDP annualized growth >= 0.0%; NO if negative.

records.question: Will the ECB reference EUR/USD exchange rate close <= 1.1200 on Friday, Feb 5, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if ECB euro reference rate for USD on Feb 5, 2027 is <= 1.1200; NO if > 1.1200.

records.question: Will the BLS first report December 2026 US Core CPI-U monthly seasonally adjusted change of at least +0.3% in its January 13, 2027 release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if first-published BLS December 2026 core CPI (all items less food and energy), seasonally adjusted month-over-month change, is >=+0.3%. Revisions published later are excluded; absent release by Jan 14 15 UTC triggers UNRESOLVABLE, not forced NO.

records.question: Will the Buffalo Bills defeat the New England Patriots in their NFL Week 13 matchup on Dec 6, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NFL.com box score records a Buffalo Bills win over New England on Dec 6, 2026; NO for loss or tie.

records.question: Will the Detroit Lions defeat the Atlanta Falcons in their NFL Week 13 matchup on Dec 6, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NFL.com box score records a Detroit Lions win at Atlanta on Dec 6, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the San Francisco 49ers defeat the New York Giants in their NFL Week 13 matchup on Dec 6, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NFL.com box score records a San Francisco 49ers win at NY Giants on Dec 6, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Georgia earn a Top-4 seed (first-round bye) in the final 2026 College Football Playoff bracket on Dec 6, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official CFP Selection Day bracket (Dec 6, 2026) awards Georgia a Top-4 seed; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Notre Dame qualify for the 12-team 2026 College Football Playoff field on Selection Day (Dec 6, 2026)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Notre Dame is selected in the 12-team CFP bracket announced Dec 6, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the Boston Celtics advance to the 2026 NBA Cup Championship Game (Dec 11, 2026)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Boston Celtics win the Eastern Conference NBA Cup Semifinal to reach the Dec 11 Final; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will either the Oklahoma City Thunder or San Antonio Spurs win the 2026 NBA Cup Championship on Dec 11, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if OKC Thunder or SA Spurs win the Dec 11, 2026 NBA Cup Final at Hinkle Fieldhouse; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Arsenal rank inside the Top 8 of the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League League Phase table after Matchday 6 (Dec 9, 2026)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official UEFA.com UCL standings place Arsenal in positions 1-8 following Matchday 6 on Dec 9, 2026; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Liverpool avoid defeat (Win or Draw) against Manchester United in their Premier League match on Nov 22, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Liverpool wins or draws vs Man United on Nov 22, 2026 per PremierLeague.com; NO if Man United wins.

records.question: Will Edmonton hold a top-three position in the NHL Pacific Division standings based on games completed through 2026-12-11, as published by 2026-12-12 15:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NHL Pacific standings after all games of Dec 11 list Edmonton in positions 1–3, applying official tiebreakers; no later games count.

records.question: Will Arsenal sit #1 in the English Premier League table at the end of Jan 1, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official PremierLeague.com standings show Arsenal #1 on Jan 1, 2027; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will at least one SEC team advance to the 2026-27 College Football Playoff Semifinals (Jan 14-15, 2027)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if >=1 SEC school wins a CFP Quarterfinal (Dec 30-Jan 1) to reach the Semifinals; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Georgia win the 2026-27 College Football Playoff National Championship on Jan 25, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Georgia wins the Jan 25, 2027 CFP National Championship in Las Vegas; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the San Francisco 49ers win the 2026 NFL NFC West division title?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NFL regular-season standings award San Francisco the NFC West title; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will either the San Francisco 49ers or Chicago Bears win the NFC Championship Game to reach Super Bowl LXI?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if San Francisco or Chicago wins the Jan 2027 NFC Championship Game; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will the Buffalo Bills win the AFC Championship Game to reach Super Bowl LXI?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Buffalo Bills win the Jan 2027 AFC Championship Game; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Manchester City finish in the Top 8 of the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League League Phase after Matchday 8 (Jan 27, 2027)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official UEFA.com standings place Man City in positions 1-8 after Matchday 8; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will either Jannik Sinner or Carlos Alcaraz win the 2027 Australian Open Men's Singles title?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Jannik Sinner or Carlos Alcaraz wins the 2027 Australian Open Men's Singles final; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Aryna Sabalenka win the 2027 Australian Open Women's Singles title?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Aryna Sabalenka wins the 2027 Australian Open Women's Singles final; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Boston lead the NBA Eastern Conference standings by official tiebreakers after games completed on 2027-02-08, verified by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official NBA East standings through games completed Feb 8 rank Boston first under NBA tiebreaking rules. Any Feb 9 games are excluded.

records.question: Will the 42nd OPEC and non-OPEC Ministerial Meeting (Nov 29, 2026) keep Q1 2027 baseline production quotas frozen (no net quota increase)?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official OPEC.org Nov 29, 2026 communique maintains current quotas into Q1 2027 without a net output hike; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Adobe Analytics report US Cyber Monday (Nov 30, 2026) online retail spending >= $15.0 billion?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Adobe Analytics official post-Cyber Monday release reports Nov 30, 2026 US online sales >= $15.0B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Adobe Analytics report US Cyber Week 2026 (Thanksgiving Nov 26 - Cyber Monday Nov 30) online spending >= $47.0 billion?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Adobe Analytics reports 5-day Cyber Week 2026 US online sales >= $47.0B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Adobe Analytics report US Black Friday (Nov 27, 2026) online retail spending >= $12.8 billion?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Adobe Analytics reports Nov 27, 2026 Black Friday US online sales >= $12.8B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ: COST) report Q1 FY2027 diluted EPS >= $4.87 in its Dec 10, 2026 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Costco's Dec 10, 2026 Q1 FY27 release reports diluted EPS >= $4.87; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Costco report Q1 FY2027 total company comparable sales growth (excluding gas/FX) >= +5.0% YoY on Dec 10, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Costco's Q1 FY27 release reports adjusted total comp sales >= +5.0% YoY; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Oracle's shareholder proposal on preservation of shareholder proposal access rights receive a majority of votes cast at the November 18, 2026 annual meeting?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Oracle's SEC Form 8-K reporting the Nov 18 annual meeting shows more FOR than AGAINST votes on Proposal 4 (exclude abstentions and broker nonvotes). If the proposal is withdrawn or not voted on, NO; if no official results by cutoff, mark UNRESOLVABLE.

records.question: Will Nike publish a specific numerical fiscal-2028 companywide revenue growth target or range in its November 17, 2026 Investor Day materials by 2026-11-21 23:59 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if Nike's official Nov 17 investor presentation, transcript or filing explicitly states an FY2028 consolidated revenue growth numerical target/range. Vague growth aspirations or category-only targets are NO.

records.question: Will JPMorganChase CFO Jeremy Barnum explicitly provide a numerical FY2027 net interest income (NII) forecast during the company's December 9, 2026 Goldman Sachs Financial Services Conference presentation, as documented in materials or a transcript made public by December 10?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if JPMorgan's official Dec 9 presentation or official transcript published by Dec 10 23:59 EST quotes a numerical full-year FY2027 NII forecast (a dollar amount or range); NO if no such number appears in those official materials by cutoff. General qualitative remarks, FY2026 guidance, or outside analyst speculation are NO.

records.question: Will Dollar General report at least $11.0 billion in Q3 fiscal 2026 consolidated net sales in its initial earnings release scheduled for December 3, 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Dollar General's first Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings release (for quarter ended Oct 30) published by December 5 at 12:00 UTC states GAAP consolidated net sales >=US$11.000 billion; NO if the published value is below US$11.000 billion. If no Q3 earnings release is available by the cutoff, mark UNRESOLVABLE rather than imputing an outcome.

records.question: Will Adobe Analytics report total Nov 1 - Dec 31, 2026 US online holiday retail sales >= $275.0 billion?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Adobe Analytics Jan 2027 full-season wrap reports Nov 1-Dec 31, 2026 US online sales >= $275.0B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will United Airlines report Q4 calendar 2026 total operating revenue growth of at least 20.0% year over year in its first official Q4 earnings release made public by January 26, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if an official United Airlines Q4 2026 earnings release available no later than 2027-01-26 23:59 UTC states year-over-year growth in consolidated total operating revenue >=20.0%, measured using GAAP revenue. NO if the value is lower; if no official Q4 release by cutoff mark UNRESOLVABLE. Exclude management guidance and non-GAAP revenue per seat mile.

records.question: Will Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) report Q4 2026 global vehicle deliveries >= 490,000 units in its Jan 2027 production/delivery release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Tesla IR's Q4 2026 Production & Deliveries release reports total deliveries >= 490,000; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Airbus deliver more commercial aircraft than Boeing for full-year 2026?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if official Jan 2027 Airbus and Boeing 2026 annual delivery totals show Airbus > Boeing; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will JPMorganChase's first official Q4 calendar 2026 earnings release report GAAP diluted earnings per share of at least $5.80, by January 16, 2027?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if JPMorgan's official 2026 Q4 financial release reports GAAP diluted EPS >=US$5.80 on or before January 16 23:59 EST; NO if lower. If no Q4 release is published by cutoff, mark UNRESOLVABLE. Exclude adjusted EPS, pre-release estimates, and revised EPS published afterward.

records.question: Will Bank of America (NYSE: BAC) report positive YoY total revenue growth (>= 0.0%) in its Jan 15, 2027 Q4 2026 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if BAC's Jan 15, 2027 Q4 2026 release reports total revenue (net of interest expense) >= Q4 2025; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX) report full-year 2026 revenue >= $51.2 billion (guidance midpoint) in its Jan 2027 Q4 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Netflix Q4 2026 shareholder letter reports FY2026 revenue >= $51.20B; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will Netflix file a US SEC Form 8-K reporting that its acquisition of Warner Bros. has officially closed by 2027-02-09 18:00 UTC?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES only if an SEC filing or formal joint Netflix/WBD closing announcement confirms the transaction closed by cutoff. HSR waiting-period expiry or nonbinding clearance without closing is NO.

records.question: Will Mastercard (NYSE: MA) report Q4 2026 net revenue growth >= +12.0% YoY in its Jan/Feb 2027 earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if Mastercard Q4 2026 earnings release reports net revenue up >= +12.0% YoY; NO otherwise.

records.question: Will FedEx (NYSE: FDX) report YoY revenue growth >= +2.0% in its Feb 2, 2027 quarterly earnings release?
records.resolutionCriteria: YES if FedEx's Feb 2, 2027 earnings release reports quarterly revenue up >= +2.0% YoY; NO otherwise.
